item.title: Microsandbox vs SmolVM vs smolBSD in 2026: Which MicroVM Sandbox Should Run Your Untrusted Code?
item.description: You just let a plugin system, a CI job, or a user-submitted script execute on your server. A container was supposed to contain it — except a container shares your kernel, and one kernel exploit later your “sandbox” is a shell on the host. Namespaces are an isolation convenience, not a security boundary. The boundary is a hypervisor, and in 2026 three projects make it cheap enough to use per-job instead of per-datacenter.

item.title: Best Self-Hosted MicroVM Platforms 2026: Firecracker vs Cloud-Hypervisor vs crosvm
item.description: MicroVMs are lightweight virtual machines that combine the isolation and security of traditional VMs with the startup speed and resource efficiency of containers. They have become the backbone of serverless computing platforms, secure container runtimes, and multi-tenant cloud infrastructure.
